integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A cinematic wide shot of a red and white lighthouse on a rocky headland at dusk. Waves roll in and break white against the dark rocks below, throwing up spray. The lighthouse beam sweeps slowly across a violet sky streaked with orange cloud. A flock of gulls glides past the tower from left to right. The camera pushes in slowly toward the lighthouse. Waves crash and hiss over the rocks while gulls call overhead.

overall_soundscape: Rolling surf and crashing waves under a steady sea wind, with gulls calling overhead.

non_diegetic_music: none

subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>, with short dark coily hair and a deep teal textured quarter-zip sweater.

summary: [reference generation] <Subject 1> walks down a rain-soaked city street at night and stops to look up at a glowing neon sign.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1>: fully_preserved - face, hairstyle, build and the teal quarter-zip sweater are retained.

detailed_description: The target video is a cinematic night scene with shallow depth of field and wet, reflective streets. [Shot 1] A medium tracking shot follows <Subject 1> as he walks toward the camera along a rain-soaked city street lit by pink and blue neon signs. Raindrops streak through the light and puddles ripple under his steps. He slows, looks up at a flickering neon sign above a shop window, and a faint smile crosses his face. The camera tracks backward at walking pace.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain on pavement, distant traffic hiss, footsteps splashing through shallow puddles, and a soft electrical hum from the neon signs.

non_diegetic_music: none

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A cinematic medium close-up inside a quiet, warmly lit bookshop at night. An elderly bookseller with round wire glasses, a neat white beard and a grey knitted cardigan sits behind a worn wooden counter stacked with old leather-bound books. A brass desk lamp glows beside him and dust drifts slowly through its light. He closes a small book, rests his hand on its cover, looks up toward the camera and smiles. The camera holds steady with a very slow push in.

The bookseller's soft, gravelly, elderly male voice (S1) says: <d>[English] Every book in here has waited years for the right reader. Take your time.</d>

overall_soundscape: A hushed room: the slow tick of a wall clock, the faint creak of the wooden counter and the soft rustle of paper, with his voice close and clear.

non_diegetic_music: none
